summary.earnings_text: Mondelez International, Inc. Class A Common Stock is expected* to report earnings on 10/29/2026 after market close. The report will be for the fiscal Quarter ending Sep 2026. According to Zacks Investment Research, based on 7 analysts' forecasts, the consensus EPS forecast for the quarter is $0.72.
